hypotheses.construction_plan: Start from the template G0(theta)*V(theta)**2. Substitute theta = p to obtain G0(p)*V(p)**2 and theta = q to obtain G0(q)*V(q)**2. Under commutative multiplication, these are respectively the same products as V(p)*G0(p)*V(p) and V(q)*G0(q)*V(q).
required_assumptions: V and G0 are univariate functions
multiplication is commutative in the ambient algebra
hypotheses.rationale: The two product subexpressions differ only by replacing p with q. Observed family F01 already reports a one-hole LGG template of the form G0(theta0)*V(theta0)**2, and observed families F02 and F03 identify G0 and V as repeated function families across the two instances.
